Patch 0.29.12 (Local authoritative unlocked talent sync now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies unlocked talent truth during delta updates: Local authoritative self sync now also stores server-sent unlocked talent lists during delta updates instead of treating that field as a change trigger without ever applying it.
  • Talent progression state stays aligned with authoritative player updates: This keeps the local progression state aligned when authoritative player updates include talent unlocks alongside ranks and points, closing one more small split in the talent sync path.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by making local authoritative progression sync more internally complete before any broader status-model work.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative unlocked talent sync and 0.29.12 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.11 (Local authoritative skill rune sync now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies skill rune truth during delta updates: Local authoritative self sync now also applies server-sent skill rune selections during delta updates instead of relying only on the separate rune message or a later full-state refresh.
  • Rune-driven behavior stays aligned with authoritative player state: This keeps rune-driven skill behavior and UI truth aligned when authoritative player updates already contain the latest rune loadout, closing another small split path in the local progression sync flow.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by making the local authoritative player path more internally complete across both combat state and progression customisation.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative skill rune sync and 0.29.11 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.10 (Local authoritative charge state now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies charge-state truth: Local authoritative self sync now also applies server-sent charge state so the local player follows the same authoritative charging flag already used by remote entity sync.
  • Charge behavior no longer depends on stale local state: This keeps local fighter charge behavior, animation selection, and related control-state checks from drifting when the server toggles charging without a separate local prediction path owning the transition.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by closing another emitted-but-not-applied self state flag in the authoritative player sync path.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative charge sync and 0.29.10 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.9 (Local authoritative scale now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies scale truth: Local authoritative self sync now also applies server-sent scale so player size changes use the same authoritative setScale path that remote entities already follow.
  • Player size no longer drifts behind server state: This keeps local range, collision, and visual scale behavior aligned when the server changes player scale instead of leaving the local actor on stale size until some later rebuild.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by closing another emitted-but-not-applied self field in the authoritative player sync path.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative scale sync and 0.29.9 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.8 (Local authoritative quest sync now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies quest truth: Local authoritative self sync now also applies quest data from entity state and delta payloads instead of depending only on separate quest update messages.
  • Quest UI stays aligned with authoritative player sync: This keeps quest objectives and journal state aligned when authoritative player sync already includes the latest quest list, reducing one more split-brain path between dedicated UI events and entity state.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by making local self sync more complete across both combat stats and progression state.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative quest sync and 0.29.8 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.7 (Local authoritative cast speed now stays aligned)

  • Local self sync now applies cast speed truth: Local authoritative self sync now also applies server-sent cast speed so that remaining derived stat truth stays aligned after full and delta updates.
  • Another emitted local stat gap is closed: This closes another emitted-but-not-applied local stat field in the 0.29 cleanup line instead of leaving cast timing modifiers stale until a later local recalculation.
  • The local stat sync path is more internally consistent: The local self-sync path now keeps base stats, regeneration, and cast speed aligned with the same authoritative payload that already drives other derived stat updates.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative cast speed sync and 0.29.7 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.6 (Local authoritative base stats now stay truthful)

  • Local self sync now applies base attribute truth: Local authoritative self sync now also applies server-sent base attributes so character-sheet base-versus-bonus breakdowns stay truthful after full and delta updates.
  • Authoritative stat migrations now stay visible in the UI: This keeps authoritative stat migration, level overrides, and other server-side base-stat changes from leaving the local UI with stale underlying attribute baselines.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by closing another local-only stat truth gap while reusing the existing self-sync structure.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative base stat sync and 0.29.6 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.5 (Local authoritative regeneration stats now stay in sync)

  • Local self sync now applies regeneration truth: Local authoritative self sync now applies server-sent HP and mana regeneration values instead of leaving those derived stats stale between full recalculations.
  • Passive sustain stays authoritative: This keeps passive sustain behavior aligned with authoritative server stats after delta and full-state updates, especially when gear, talents, or effects change regeneration mid-session.
  • The 0.29 cleanup line continues: The 0.29 cleanup line continues by closing another small local-only derived-stat sync gap without widening the broader status-model design.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for local authoritative regeneration sync and 0.29.5 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.4 (Boosted Spirit Guardians now stays authoritative across compressed sync)

  • Boosted guardians now stay on the authoritative path: Boosted Spirit Guardians now syncs through both the server delta snapshot tracker and the client-side shared support helper instead of dropping that boosted state on compressed updates.
  • Guardian boost metadata now matches the rest of the support sync line: This keeps guardian boost metadata aligned with the rest of the authoritative support-state replication path, so boosted guardians stay visible and mechanically correct after the initial cast snapshot.
  • Buff tracking stays truthful: The active buff tracker can now keep showing boosted guardians from authoritative state instead of silently falling back to the normal guardian variant.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for boosted guardian delta tracking, boosted guardian client sync, and 0.29.4 version presentation.

Patch 0.29.3 (Spirit Guardians now reliably triggers compressed server state updates)

  • Guardian delta sync now participates in server change tracking: Spirit Guardians state now participates in the server delta snapshot change tracker, so guardian-only activation and expiry cannot get skipped by compressed state broadcasts.
  • The server support-state set is more internally consistent: This keeps the server delta path aligned with the newer support-effect replication set instead of leaving Spirit Guardians outside the consolidated comparison block.
  • Client readability now gets a steadier authoritative trigger: Nearby guardian state readability and the shared client-side support sync path now have a more reliable authoritative trigger to react to.
  • Regression coverage: Added server regression coverage for Spirit Guardians delta snapshot tracking and 0.29.3 version presentation.
